summary: Iter3 backend + frontend testing complete. Iter2 regression: 12/12 PASS. critical_code_review_comments: iter3_router.py correctly enforces tenant isolation on all new endpoints (drawing_markups filtered by tenant_id via tenant_filter; photos and specs search routed through tenant-scoped services).
DrawingMarkupCreate uses Literal types for markup_type + linked_entity_type — enforces pin polymorphism at the Pydantic layer (good; prevents invalid linked entity types).
Photo upload validates size (<=10MB), extension allowlist (jpg/png/webp/heic), rejects empty bodies — reasonable.
Spec search handles empty projects gracefully (returns [] not 500); reindex correctly dispatched via BackgroundTasks.
The drawing revision upload accepts revision_label form field (not revision_code) — test doc/tests should reflect this naming.
Spec upload is two-step (POST /specs to create row, then POST /specs/{id}/upload for PDF) — not a single 'create+upload' endpoint. Acceptable but worth documenting.

2.5D Spatial3D renders in raw three.js — confirmed working via screenshot (rooms extruded on floor grid with legend + CP highlight + Z-slice controls). No React-error-overlay observed; R3F avoidance strategy validated.
seed_data_creation: 1 TEST_ drawing + 1 uploaded revision, 3 drawing_markups (1 deleted), 1 TEST_photo (uploaded via test + 1 via UI), 1 TEST_ project_spec with ingested PDF, 1 other-tenant 'other3-XXXX' user. All cleanly scoped.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 iter3 features pass backend + frontend critical paths. Use test_iteration3.py for regression. Key learnings: (1) /api/drawings requires sheet_number (not drawing_number); (2) /api/drawing-revisions/upload accepts revision_label (not revision_code); (3) spec upload is two-step: POST /api/specs (create row) then POST /api/specs/{id}/upload (attach PDF); (4) after spec PDF upload, poll GET /api/projects/{project_id}/specs and check processing_status=='complete' (takes ~1-5s for reportlab PDFs with DIVISION 03/SECTION 03 30 00); (5) sidebar collapse localStorage key is 'ice.sidebar.collapsed' with JSON {"SECTION TITLE":true}; (6) /spatial-3d uses raw three.js — canvas rendered, no R3F, runtime overlay absent. The voice FAB → EntityFromVoiceDialog flow was not UI-tested because headless cannot record audio; backend POST /api/voice/annotate was validated in iter2 regression and did not 500. Drawing markup persistence via DrawingViewer PDF-render was not UI-tested because it requires pdf.js canvas interaction — backend contract fully verified.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues.
